hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); c=open('docs/go-style.md').read() if fp.endswith('.go') else None; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','additionalContext':c}})) if c else None" 2>/dev/null || true

python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); c=open('docs/go-style.md').read() if fp.endswith('.go') else None; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','additionalContext':c}})) if c else None" 2>/dev/null || true

CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: knowledge graph at graphify-out/. For focused questions, run `graphify query \"<question>\"` (scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md) instead of grepping raw files. Read GRAPH_REPORT.md only for broad architecture context."}}'   || true ;; esac

ST=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('subagent_type',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$ST" in Explore|general-purpose)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: knowledge graph at graphify-out/. Before spawning this exploration agent, try graphify yourself first: run graphify query <seeded with an actual class/function/file name, not a vague phrase> (or graphify explain / graphify path). One good query often returns the whole relevant slice in seconds - cheaper than a subagent trace. Only fall back to this agent if graphify does not surface enough."}}'   || true ;; esac

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$file" | grep -qE 'migrations/[^/]+\.sql$' && goose -dir ./migrations postgres "host=localhost port=15433 user=artel dbname=artel_db sslmode=disable" down && goose -dir ./migrations postgres "host=localhost port=15433 user=artel dbname=artel_db sslmode=disable" up || true

[ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && git status --porcelain -- '*.go' '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.sql' '*.proto' 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && find . \( -name node_modules -o -name graphify-out -o -name .git -o -name worktrees \) -prune -o \( -name '*.go' -o -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.sql' -o -name '*.proto' \) -newer graphify-out/graph.json -print 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"graphify-out/ is stale relative to source changes made this turn. Run `graphify update .` before finishing."}' || true
